items.text: Ifan examination question asksyou to write out the equation forcalculating density,mass orvolume,always give the actual equation in words or using m The unitsfordensity depend on the units used formass and volume.lf mass ismeasured in kilograms andvolume in cubic metres,the units for density are kilogramsper cubicmetre (kg/m3).Density can alsobe measured in gramsper cubiccentimetre(g/cm²).

items.label: text
items.text: Apieceofiron has a massof390kg and a volume of0.05m.What is its density?

items.label: text
items.text: The density of a substance canbe determined by measuring the mass and volume ofa sample of the material,and then calculating the density.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Figure 18.3 a The volume of a regular solid can be calculated by multiplying its length (0 width (w) and height (h). b The volume of an irregular object can be determined using a displacement can and ameasuringcylinder.

items.label: text
items.text: Usea half-metre rule to measure thelength,width and height of a regular solid.Whenmeasuring thevolume of theliquid thatisdisplaced(pushed out)by an irregularsolid make sure that themeasuring cylinder is on a level (horizontal) surface and thatyoulook at the scale straight on as shown (to avoidparallax error).

items.label: text
items.text: You thenneed to measure the mass of the solid.Use weighing scales for this.
